newsitem.title: USA: Cerion seen as takeover target - report.
newsitem.headline: Cerion seen as takeover target - report.

text.p: Cerion Technologies Inc could emerge as a takeover target, according to a report in Business Week.

Bill Hopke of Trilon Dominion Partners thinks some of Cerion's customers could be interested in acquiring the company, with the stock falling from its initial public offering price of $13 a share, according to Business Week.
Trilon Dominion holds almost five percent of Cerion, which makes disks for small, high-capacity computer drives.
Cerion closed at 3-1/2 in Nasdaq trading Thursday.
Hopke said companies that may have an interest in acquiring Cerion include International Business Machines Corp and an large Taiwanese computer maker, which was not named in the article.
